card.name: Punctuation before listed interacting drugs
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (a comma, 'and', a colon after 'Examples', 'such as') that come right before a drug name in an interaction list for diabetes medicines.

modes.label: List joiner
modes.description: The comma or 'and' inside a run of interacting drug names.
modes.example: Alcohol, Beta-blockers, Clonidine,<< and>> Lithium Salts Prevention or Management Monitor

modes.label: Introducing examples
modes.description: A colon after 'Examples' or 'such as' that leads into named drugs.
modes.example: Consider reducing the dose of the carbonic anhydrase inhibitor. Evaluate the patients for any adverse effects from the carbonic anhydrase inhibitor. Examples<<:>> Acetazolamide, methaz

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward starting a drug name next, and away from words beginning with 'rel'.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a list of named interacting drugs is about to continue or begin.
